references.text: Here is given the original instruction concerning the peace offering (זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים), which Leviticus 7:11 further elaborates with detailed regulations.
Continuation of the regulations for the peace offering, describing the various types: thank offerings, vow offerings, and freewill offerings.
Further provisions regarding the peace offering, specifically concerning the priests' share of the sacrifice.
Repeats instructions on how the peace offering is to be sacrificed and eaten in the proper manner.
Mentions the peace offering (זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים) in connection with vows and freewill offerings to the Lord.
The Nazirite's peace offering as part of the conclusion of the Nazirite vow.
The peace offering is mentioned in connection with celebrations of joy and festivals.
Early reference to peace offerings (זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים) at the covenant of Sinai.
Ezekiel's vision of the future temple includes peace offerings on the altar.
